## Why

## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally (fmt, vet, lint, test)
- [ ] Migrations are expand-contract and reversible, or a forward fix is documented (ADR-020)

- [ ] Decisions stay consistent with the ADRs; any deviation is called out
